flavour_text: It is highly popular among female Trainers for its sublime fur. It does not keep a nest.

name: Kecleon

1.name: Samesies Slap
1.effect: If this Pokémon and your opponent's Active Pokémon have 1 or more of the same type of Energy attached, this attack does 30 more damage.

flavour_text: It changes color to blend in with its surroundings in order to sneak up on prey. It can’t make its belly pattern disappear, however.

name: Pidove
flavour_text: It’s forgetful and not very bright, but many Trainers love it anyway for its friendliness and sincerity.

name: Tranquill
flavour_text: These bright Pokémon have acute memories. Apparently delivery workers often choose them as their partners.

name: Unfezant

1.name: Fly
1.effect: Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing. If heads, during your opponent's next turn, prevent all damage from—and effects of—attacks done to this Pokémon.

flavour_text: This Pokémon is intelligent and intensely proud. People will sit up and take notice if you become the Trainer of one.

name: Ducklett
flavour_text: It strengthens its body by diving into the depths of ponds, swimming around while looking for bog moss to eat.

1.name: Jet Wing
1.effect: During your next turn, this Pokémon can't attack.

name: Furfrou

ability.name: Fur Coat
ability.effect: This Pokémon takes −20 damage from attacks.

1.effect: If any of your Pokémon were Knocked Out by damage from an attack during your opponent's last turn, this attack does 50 more damage.

flavour_text: Left alone, its fur will grow longer and longer, but it will only allow someone it trusts to cut it.

name: Type: Null
flavour_text: It was modeled after a mighty Pokémon of myth. The mask placed upon it limits its power in order to keep it under control.

name: Silvally

1.name: Gold Breaker
1.effect: If your opponent's Active Pokémon is a Pokémon ex, this attack does 90 more damage.

flavour_text: The final factor needed to release this Pokémon’s true power was a strong bond with a Trainer it trusts.

card_text: Prevent all effects of attacks used by your opponent's Pokémon done to the Pokémon this card is attached to. (Existing effects are not removed.)

name: Wally

name: Wurmple
flavour_text: It lives among the tall grass and in forests. It repels attacks by raising up the spikes on its rear.

name: Lileep

1.name: Blot
1.effect: Heal 10 damage from this Pokémon.

flavour_text: Lileep clings to rocks on the seabed. When prey comes close, this Pokémon entangles it with petallike tentacles.

name: Kricketune
flavour_text: There is a village that hosts a contest based on the amazingly variable cries of this Pokémon.

name: Accelgor

1.name: Deck and Cover
1.effect: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Poisoned and Paralyzed. Shuffle this Pokémon and all attached cards into your deck.

flavour_text: Discarding its shell made it nimble. To keep itself from dehydrating, it wraps its body in bands of membrane.

name: Ponyta

1.name: Stoke
1.effect: Take a [R] Energy from your Energy Zone and attach it to this Pokémon.

flavour_text: If you’ve been accepted by Ponyta, its burning mane is mysteriously no longer hot to the touch.

name: Quilava

1.name: Heat Wave
1.effect: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Burned.

flavour_text: The fur covering this Pokémon’s body never burns, no matter what. It can shrug off any kind of fire attack.

name: Kyogre

1.name: Tidal Blast
1.effect: Discard 3 [W] Energy from this Pokémon, and this attack does 50 damage to each of your opponent's Pokémon.

flavour_text: It is said to have widened the seas by causing downpours. It had been asleep in a marine trench.

name: Samurott

ability.name: Stance
ability.effect: Once during your turn, when you play this Pokémon from your hand to evolve 1 of your Pokémon, you may prevent all damage from—and effects of—attacks from your opponent's Pokémon done to this Pokémon until the end of your opponent's next turn.

1.name: Pike
1.effect: This attack also does 20 damage to 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon.

flavour_text: Samurott leads its group strictly. Those who do not follow its rules receive a merciless thrashing.

name: Raichu

ability.name: Evoshock
ability.effect: Once during your turn, when you play this Pokémon from your hand to evolve 1 of your Pokémon, you may flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

flavour_text: If the electric pouches in its cheeks become fully charged, both ears will stand straight up.

name: Wattrel
flavour_text: These Pokémon make their nests on coastal cliffs. The nests have a strange, crackling texture, and they’re a popular delicacy.

name: Clefairy

1.name: Mini-Metronome
1.effect: Flip a coin. If heads, choose 1 of your opponent's Active Pokémon's attacks and use it as this attack.

flavour_text: On nights with a full moon, they gather together and dance. The surrounding area is enveloped in an abnormal magnetic field.

name: Ralts

1.name: Lead
1.effect: Put a random Supporter card from your deck into your hand.

flavour_text: It is highly attuned to the emotions of people and Pokémon. It hides if it senses hostility.

name: Wynaut

1.name: Stompy Jammer
1.effect: During your opponent's next turn, attacks used by the Defending Pokémon cost 1 [C] more.

flavour_text: It tends to move in a pack with others. They cluster in a tight group to sleep in a cave.

name: Oricorio

1.name: Supernatural Feather
1.effect: Discard a card from your hand. If you can't, this attack does nothing.

flavour_text: The elegant, attractive dance of these Oricorio is popular with adults, but the Oricorio themselves are hard to find in Paldea.

name: Anorith
flavour_text: Anorith can swim swiftly by pulling its eight wings through the water like oars on a boat. This Pokémon is an ancestor of modern bug Pokémon.

name: Poochyena

1.name: Team Hunt
1.effect: Draw a card for each Poochyena you have in play.

flavour_text: Poochyena pursue their prey in packs. Once the prey is exhausted, the pack finishes it off. But sometimes the prey retaliates, and the pack flees.

name: Gulpin
flavour_text: It has a small heart and brain. Its stomach comprises most of its body, with enzymes to dissolve anything.

name: Vullaby

1.name: Run Around
1.effect: Switch this Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

flavour_text: Its healthy appetite leads to visible growth spurts. It often has to replace the bones it wears as its size increases.

name: Genesect

1.name: Techno Blast
1.effect: During your next turn, this Pokémon can't attack.

flavour_text: This Pokémon existed 300 million years ago. Team Plasma altered it and attached a cannon to its back.

name: Dragonair

ability.name: Dragon’s Blessing
ability.effect: Once during your turn, if this Pokémon is on your Bench, you may attach an Energy from your discard pile to your Active [N] Pokémon.

flavour_text: It is called the divine Pokémon. When its entire body brightens slightly, the weather changes.

name: Noivern

1.name: Draco Meteor
1.effect: 1 of your opponent's Pokémon is chosen at random 3 times. For each time a Pokémon was chosen, do 60 damage to it.

flavour_text: In the dark, even Hydreigon are terrified of this Pokémon. But in the light, Noivern is the one that avoids battle.

name: Cyclizar

1.name: Acceleration Drive
1.effect: Flip a coin. If heads, during your opponent's next turn, prevent all damage from—and effects of—attacks done to this Pokémon.

flavour_text: It can sprint at over 70 mph while carrying a human. The rider’s body heat warms Cyclizar’s back and lifts the Pokémon’s spirit.

name: Aipom
flavour_text: Its tail moves with greater dexterity than its hands. Making deft use of this tail, Aipom lives high among the treetops.

name: Mudkip

name: Marshtomp
flavour_text: It is at its best when on muddy ground that offers poor footing. It quickly overwhelms opponents that are bogged down and unable to move.

name: Swampert

name: Electabuzz
flavour_text: Research is progressing on storing lightning in Electabuzz so this energy can be used at any time.

name: Plusle

1.name: Electric Tail
1.effect: Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

flavour_text: This Pokémon absorbs electricity from telephone poles. It shorts out the electricity stored inside its body to create noises.

name: Minun

name: Mr. Mime

1.name: Synchro Dance
1.effect: If this Pokémon and your opponent's Active Pokémon have the same amount of Energy attached, this attack does 40 more damage.

flavour_text: It’s known for its top-notch pantomime skills. It protects itself from all sorts of attacks by emitting auras from its fingers to create walls.

name: Mewtwo

1.name: Psychic

flavour_text: The research efforts of a certain scientist ultimately resulted in this Pokémon. Its powers are dedicated to battling.

name: Roggenrola
flavour_text: When it detects a noise, it starts to move. The energy core inside it makes this Pokémon slightly warm to the touch.

name: Boldore
flavour_text: It relies on sound in order to monitor what’s in its vicinity. When angered, it will attack without ever changing the direction it’s facing.

name: Falinks

ability.name: Coordinated Unit
ability.effect: If you have another Falinks in play, this Pokémon's attacks do +20 damage to your opponent's Active Pokémon, and this Pokémon takes −20 damage from attacks from your opponent's Pokémon.

name: Koffing

1.name: Gas Bomb
1.effect: This Pokémon also does 10 damage to itself.

flavour_text: Toxic gas is held within its thin, balloon-shaped body, so it can cause massive explosions.

name: Weezing
flavour_text: When it inhales poisonous gases from garbage, its body expands, and its insides smell much worse.

name: Galarian Meowth
flavour_text: These daring Pokémon have coins on their foreheads. Darker coins are harder, and harder coins garner more respect among Meowth.

name: Galarian Perrserker
